item.title: Historic New York church to hold special service for Claudette Colvin
item.description: A historic New York church is set to hold a special tribute service honoring Claudette Colvin, who refused to give up her bus seat in Montgomery nine months before Rosa Parks did.

item.title: City of Pelham receives money to remove railroad crossings
item.description: The city of Pelham has received a big financial boost. The funds will help curb traffic problems trains cause in the community.

item.title: City of Jasper introduces committee to address homelessness
item.description: The city of Jasper is working to help those who are unhoused in the community.

item.title: Alabama junior hockey player remembered after deadly crash in Canada
item.description: A former member of the Birmingham Jr. Bulls is being remembered. Caden Fine, 17, is one of three teenage hockey players killed in a car crash in Alberta, Canada, on Monday.

item.title: Birmingham Police Department discusses crime reduction efforts
item.description: The Birmingham Police Department is holding a press conference regarding crime reduction Tuesday.

item.title: Fairfield High Preparatory School honors the life of head football coach Shepherd Skanes
item.description: Fairfield High Preparatory School announced Tuesday the death of beloved head football coach, social studies teach and mentor Shepherd Skanes.

item.title: 75-year-old woman reported missing in Birmingham
item.description: The Birmingham Police Department is asking for the public's help in finding a missing 75-year-old woman who was reportedly last early Tuesday morning.

item.title: Man found dead following Birmingham crash had been shot
item.description: A man was determined to have been shot after he was found dead in an overturned vehicle in Birmingham on Tuesday afternoon.
